decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control spells like Counterspell, Fatal Push, and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also includes powerful creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Tasigur, the Golden Fang to apply pressure and close out the game. With a mix of card draw, removal, and counter magic, the deck aims to grind out incremental advantages and maintain control over the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Subtlety and Psychic Frog provide additional disruption and flexibility in dealing with threats.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disruption and control. With a mix of counterspells, hand disruption, removal, and card advantage, the deck aims to control the game and prevent the opponent from executing their game plan. The key strategy involves countering key spells, removing threats, and controlling the board until the player can establish their own win condition. With a mix of disruptive creatures and powerful spells, the deck looks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a long game.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive strategy focused on creatures with various abilities to deal damage quickly. The deck includes creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Voice of Victory to put pressure on the opponent, supported by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Prismatic Ending. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional buffs to the team, while cards like Goblin Bombardment and Guide of Souls offer additional utility and removal options. The deck's mana base allows for smooth ramp-up and color fixing for consistent early-game aggression.

The deck focuses on disrupting and controlling the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful win conditions that generate advantage. It aims to outvalue the opponent by utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Fell the Profane to dismantle their strategy while deploying threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Psychic Frog to close out the game. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for smooth casting of both spells and creatures.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful combat tricks. By playing creatures like Ajani, Guide of Souls, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment, the deck aims to quickly deal damage and control the board. Seasoned Pyromancer and Ranger-Captain of Eos provide card advantage and flexibility, while cards like Thraben Charm and Voice of Victory give additional combat tricks. Blood Moon can disrupt the opponent's mana base, giving the deck an edge in the late game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deploy powerful threats onto the battlefield and apply pressure to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Detective's Phoenix, Hollow One, and Nethergoyf, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Lightning Bolt, Fatal Push, and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting help to dig for key cards and provide card advantage. Overall, the deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays to outpace the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo using artifacts and various synergies to generate advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to control the board through cards like Portable Hole and Metallic Rebuke while leveraging powerful cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Oswald Fiddlebender to set up the combo. The deck utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal to generate mana and card advantage, while also incorporating powerful synergies with Urza's Saga and Aether Spellbomb. Through careful manipulation of artifacts and resources, the deck aims to win the game in a decisive and explosive manner.

The main concept of this Ruby Storm deck is to quickly generate mana through the use of ritual spells and mana-producing cards like Ruby Medallion and Manamorphose. By casting spells efficiently and utilizing cards like Ral, Monsoon Mage to increase spell damage, the deck aims to combo off and deal a large amount of damage in a single turn, ultimately winning the game. The deck also includes card draw and recursion elements with Past in Flames and Wish to ensure consistency and resilience. The land base includes fetch lands and dual lands to support the deck's color requirements.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play big, game-winning threats like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. The key to the strategy lies in utilizing cards like Arboreal Grazer, Amulet of Vigor, and multiple land bounce lands to generate insane amounts of mana and power out threats ahead of schedule. With cards like Scapeshift and Green Sun's Zenith as additional search options, the deck is designed to consistently and efficiently assemble the pieces needed to execute its powerful combo finish.

This aggressive Boros deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures and utilizing powerful synergies to overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of creatures that generate value upon entering the battlefield and spells that can deal direct damage or provide additional support, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain tempo throughout the game. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah allows for additional reach and flexibility in how the deck can close out games.

The deck focuses on using creatures with varying abilities and synergies to quickly assemble a powerful board state. By utilizing cards like Green Sun's Zenith to tutor for specific creatures, and Leyline of Abundance to generate additional mana, the deck aims to create a combo that can overwhelm the opponent in a single turn. The toolbox nature of the deck allows for flexibility in adapting to different matchups, while still maintaining a consistent game plan of ramping into powerful threats like Craterhoof Behemoth and Tyvar, the Pummeler.

The deck focuses on using creatures as a toolbox to assemble a powerful combo, utilizing cards like Devoted Druid and Walking Ballista to generate infinite mana, while also having access to a variety of creatures for different situations thanks to Green Sun's Zenith. Leyline of Abundance and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler help ramp up mana production, while Finale of Devastation and Craterhoof Behemoth serve as finishers. The deck also includes disruption with Fatal Push and has some strong utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a versatile and powerful creature-based strategy.

The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly using Eldrazi Temple and Talisman of Resilience, while controlling the board with cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Malevolent Rumble. Emrakul, the Promised End serves as a powerful finisher once enough mana is accumulated. Ugin, Eye of the Storms provides additional control with its abilities. The deck also includes various Eldrazi creatures and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on accelerating mana production using cards like Disciple of Freyalise and Eldrazi Temple to quickly ramp into powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It also utilizes control elements such as Kozilek's Command and Ugin, Eye of the Storms to disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with massive Eldrazi creatures while maintaining control over the game through removal and disruption spells. Additionally, it includes cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Fight Rigging to search for specific threats and protect key creatures.

The deck focuses on quickly and efficiently reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Superior Spider-Man using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to protect the combo and control the game. The deck utilizes a mix of blue, white, and black mana sources to cast its spells, and includes utility lands like Meticulous Archive and Undercity Sewers to further support its game plan. With the right draws and careful sequencing, the deck can achieve its combo win condition and overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through ritual spells and mana generation cards like Ruby Medallion, in order to cast powerful spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames multiple times. The key strategy is to efficiently chain spells together to create a storm of spells, ultimately leading to a lethal Grapeshot or Artist's Talent. The deck also includes cards like Wrenn's Resolve and Valakut Awakening to help dig for key combo pieces and maintain card advantage.
